# MCPEncode

> Self-hosted web app and MCP server. People keep Libraries of Items and Publish them; AI agents connect to one Library through its Connect link (MCP over HTTP) to look Items up and draft changes. Node.js 22 + PostgreSQL 16+, one container, built-in OAuth 2.1 sign-in or external OIDC.

To deploy: `scripts/init-env.sh` then `docker compose up -d --build`, check `GET /healthz` returns `{"status":"ok","database":"ok"}`, open the URL and create the first account with `SETUP_TOKEN` from `.env`. Settings are validated by `npm run check-env`.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/hkrlogic/MCPEncode/blob/main/AGENTS.md): canonical guide for AI agents: deploy commands, required settings, verification, common failures, tests, contribution rules
- [README.md](https://github.com/hkrlogic/MCPEncode/blob/main/README.md): what it is and the 4-step quick start
